messages.author: 30b37db3d992e3df
messages.subject: Still knmodels problems
parts:
I'm glad to report that the testing version of
inla.knmodels  (23.06.29) solved the n-not-found
problem from a previous posting. But I'm still having
trouble getting any knmodel setup to work.

Here's an example, drawn from Ch 7 of Blangiardo+Cameletti


################### R code begins

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(scale.model.default=FALSE)

set.seed(12345)
require(maptools)

my.dir <- "c:/work/R/blangiardo/"

################### setup for work: this code is from the book
################### or the code from the book website

data <- read.csv(paste(my.dir,"LBWGeorgiaData/data.final.csv",sep=""))
georgia <- readShapePoly(paste(my.dir,"LBWGeorgiaData/co13_d00.shp",sep=""))

# Remove duplicates (area 88 and 94)
names <- georgia$NAME
georgia <- georgia[-c(99,100,105,137),]
data.georgia <- attr(georgia, "data")

low.vector <- as.vector(as.matrix(data[,2:12])) #by column
E.vector <- as.vector(as.matrix(data[,13:23]))  #by column
year <- numeric(0)
for(i in 1:11){
  year<- append(year,rep(i,dim(data)[1]))
}

# county replicates the county names 11 times
county <- as.factor(rep(data[,1],11))

data <- data.frame(y= low.vector, E= E.vector, ID.area=as.numeric(county),
                   ID.area1=as.numeric(county), year=year,
                   ID.year = year, ID.year1=year, ID.area.year = seq(1,length(county)))


# Spatial graph
Georgia.adj <- paste(my.dir,"LBWGeorgiaData/Georgia.graph",sep="")
# Temporal graph
Temp.adj <- paste(my.dir,"LBWGeorgiaData/Temp.graph",sep="")

data$ID.area.int <- data$ID.area
data$ID.year.int <- data$ID.year



######################### now a Type-I model as in the book

formula.intI<- y ~ f(ID.area,model="bym", graph=Georgia.adj) +
  f(ID.year,model="rw2") + f(ID.year1,model="iid") + f(ID.area.year,model="iid")

mod.intI <- inla(formula.intI,family="poisson",data=data,E=E,
                 control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))

print(summary(mod.intI))
# runs fine

####################### next, try to set up for knmodels

data$ID.spacetime<-1:nrow(data)

# formula.base is formula.int1 minus the spacetime spec (last term)
formula.base<- y ~ f(ID.area,model="bym", graph=Georgia.adj) +
  f(ID.year,model="rw2") + f(ID.year1,model="iid")

mod.kh1<-inla.knmodels(formula.base,family="poisson",data=data,E=E,
               control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
               control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE),
               control.st=list(time=ID.year1, space=ID.area,
                     spacetime=ID.spacetime, graph=Georgia.adj, type=c(1)),
               control.inla=list(strategy='gaussian')  )
Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)) :
  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for
  function 'which': 'list' object cannot be coerced to type 'integer'


################### R code ends.  comments/ questions

1. Is my translation of the book model to the knmodel correct?
2. I get this error message doing the same thing for
   a model in the Ravishankar "Dynamic Time Series Models ... " book.
3. Omitting the control.inla spec doesn't help.
